snippet.description:
Trying to remember everything in one sitting can make studying stressful. Sonali Ma’am explains memory through an example: watching a series. Spreading episodes out and discussing them repeatedly makes recall easier. The same applies to UPSC preparation. Revision, reflection and connecting ideas to your own life help make information more retrievable. Give your brain time to process what you study.
